g.title: cluster_pipe
g.text: 2 · One pipeline · the model is a step inside it

g.title: q
g.text: Read-only query against a saved connection

g.title: scale
g.text: Next: the full ~12 GB event log

g.title: shard
g.text: each node reads only the partitions it holds

g.title: feat
g.text: point-in-time; the cutoff is never guessed

g.title: train
g.text: gradient-boosted trees on the account's own columns

g.title: shap
g.text: TreeSHAP, per row and per population

g.title: atrisk
g.text: outlives the run that produced it

g.title: blocker
g.text: Open: one defect in the API layer stops read requests
being served after a run finishes. The pipeline itself is
verified; this blocks the live click-through only.

g.title: infer
g.text: Score an account not in the data
a missing feature fails, never zero-fills

g.title: report
g.text: Next: the report as an artifact

g.title: q3
g.text: "Which accounts are most at risk, and why?"
